profile.headline: Project Manager | UI/UX Designer | Bridging Design & Development
profile.summary:
As a results-driven marketing strategist and creative problem solver, I specialize in scaling high-ticket consumer brands through performance marketing, data-driven funnels, and conversion-optimized landing experiences. Throughout my career, I’ve combined business acumen, creative direction, and technical insight to launch campaigns that move the needle — not just impressions.

With deep experience in B2B and DTC environments, I’ve partnered closely with creative teams, engineers, and media buyers to build full-funnel strategies that turn clicks into revenue. My approach is hands-on, execution-focused, and centered around aligning customer psychology with brand positioning.

A few standout accomplishments I’m proud of:

Led multi-channel launches for luxury and tech-forward consumer products, resulting in 6-figure ROAS within 90 days
Designed and optimized over 100 high-converting landing pages for e-commerce and SaaS brands
Scaled programmatic ad campaigns for national franchises and software platforms with budgets exceeding $100K/month
Spearheaded integrated campaigns that combined paid media, email, and content to shorten sales cycles and boost lead quality
I’m passionate about great user experiences, strategic storytelling, and building marketing engines that scale.

Let’s connect — especially if you’re building something bold.

positions.title: Web Developer and Designer
positions.locationName: Long Beach, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Web Design & User Experience (UX/UI):

Custom Website Design - 
Designed and developed modern, user-friendly websites tailored for service-based businesses.

Responsive & Mobile Optimization - 
Ensured seamless user experiences across all devices by optimizing layouts, images, and interactive elements.

Branding & Visual Identity - 
Created cohesive brand identities, including custom typography, color schemes, and imagery to align with business goals.

User Experience (UX) Enhancement - Designed intuitive navigation structures, clear call-to-actions (CTAs), and optimized layouts to improve client engagement and conversions.

Web Development & Functionality:
Custom Code Implementation - 
Enhanced Squarespace’s default capabilities with custom CSS, JavaScript, and HTML for tailored functionality.

Third-Party Integrations - 
Implemented tools such as booking systems (Acuity, Calendly), CRM platforms, email marketing (Mailchimp, ConvertKit), and payment gateways to streamline business operations.

Advanced Customization - Modified Squarespace templates beyond standard design settings to match unique business requirements.

SEO & Performance Optimization - 
Structured metadata, improved website loading speed, and implemented SEO best practices for increased search visibility.

Quality Assurance & Client Support:

Cross-Browser & Device Testing - Conducted rigorous testing to ensure compatibility across all major browsers and devices.

Troubleshooting & Debugging - Resolved issues related to website performance, integrations, and custom-coded elements.

Client Training & Documentation -  Provided step-by-step guidance and documentation for business owners to manage and update their websites independently.

Ongoing Website Maintenance - Offered continued support for updates, security enhancements, and performance improvements.

positions.title: Media Project Manager
positions.description:
Developed compelling project pitch decks to attract and secure potential investors.

Created and implemented strategic marketing plans to enhance brand visibility and audience engagement.

Led the branding process, ensuring cohesive visual identity and messaging across all media platforms.

Coordinated with various media teams, including videographers, graphic designers, web developers, and program developers, to bring creative visions to life.

Utilized Figma to design high-fidelity prototypes for websites, e-commerce stores, and landing pages, optimizing user experience.

Applied SEO best practices, including keyword research, on-page optimization (meta tags, headings, alt text), content strategy, technical SEO audits, and backlink building, to improve search engine rankings and increase organic traffic.

Analyzed website performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and other SEO tools, identifying areas for optimization and growth.

Managed project timelines and deliverables, ensuring seamless execution from concept to completion.
positions.insights: Skills: Figma (Software) · WordPress · Adobe Photoshop · Status Tracking · Business Research · Media Development · Production Experience · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · E-commerce Optimization · Adobe Illustrator · Adobe Premiere Pro

positions.title: VP of Merchant Processing
positions.description:
Project Management: Lead high-stakes initiatives, ensuring on-time, within-budget delivery while surpassing customer and business goals.

Team Leadership: Direct web development and merchant services teams, maintaining operational efficiency and merchant account health.

Strategic Partnerships: Collaborate with Processing Agents and Acquirers to implement new solutions, ensure compliance, and sustain account performance.

Digital Optimization: Develop landing pages, workflows, PCI compliance protocols, and CRM integrations to enhance user experience and sales efficiency.

Analytics & Risk Mitigation: Monitor key metrics, improve conversion rates, and recommend strategies to reduce chargebacks and optimize customer service.

Revenue Growth: Spearheaded efforts achieving $1.5M monthly merchant processing capacity and $10M annual sales amidst global challenges.
